country.evidence_quote: Serving the needs of Car Wash Owners since 1967, Windtrax remains a family opened and operated business dedicated to providing the best customer service in the business. Local sales of car wash supplies, parts, equipment and full systems throughout Southwest Ohio and the Kansas City area with an enormous selection of everything for every type of car wash shipped to you quickly throughout North America.

contact.name: Peggy Wilhelm
contact.evidence_quote: Marvin Wilhelm established Windtrax in 1974. Starting with a car wash and laundromat in Merriam, Kansas, Marvin and his wife Peggy bought and sold car washes. Over time, the number of car washes they owned increased and Marvin developed an inventory of supplies and spare parts to keep the car washes operating. When other owners had something break at their car washes, they often went to Marvin and asked to purchase a spare part or two from him. As more car wash owners purchased items from Marvin ... Marvin and Peggy Wilhelm worked hard to build this family-owned business into what it is today. Just ask anyone around here and they will tell you that Marvin is the car wash expert. And Marvin has passed that expertise on to the next generation, which is now responsible for the daily operations of Windtrax.
